name: Root Choir
description: Liquid Script: tapered amber, magenta, and violet ink gestures write themselves across a charcoal field, braid through a persistent non-radial liquid flow, and dissolve before they congeal. Bass deviation continuously changes advection; beat onsets accent newly written local gestures. No global rotation, particle rings, central knot, or white bloom.
